name: s3d-plugin-physics
description: Physics on the model for Shap3D.ai: groups and components become rigid bodies that fall, bounce, slide and collide; hinges, sliders, motors with programs and ropes for robot arms and machines; thrust, drag and wind for things that fly; water that floats bodies, a particle liquid and a wind tunnel that shows the flow around objects – with Rapier as WebAssembly, without changing the model.
